_note: The void's mind, kept apart from the element physics (BAUPLAN M1c): src/combat/madness_rules.gd (MadnessRules) reads this file; src/combat/element_rules.gd keeps forwarders for its old callers. madness = WAHN, what the void does to minds (moved here from element_rules.json); gefuege = the Leerenmagier's Arkanes Gefüge, the talent store his void feeds (moved here from element_rules.json). The physics that puts the madness on (the void pool and gas status mad) stays in element_rules.json mediums / gases.

madness._note: WAHN (user decision 2026-10-31, the Old Gods): the void drives minds mad (src/combat/madness_rules.gd, MadnessRules; the crypt in src/game.gd + src/crypt_enemy_ai.gd, the story worlds in src/hell/hell_monsters.gd + src/hell/hell_game.gd). A creature standing in a void pool or void gas (mediums.void / gases.void status mad [strength, s], refreshed while inside) or hit by a void spell is mad for that long: its shots scatter by up to aim_scatter rad, it staggers sideways (wobble px/s, a new step every wobble_step s), and at each attack decision it turns with turn_chance on the nearest other creature within turn_reach px and really attacks it, for at most turn_hold s (decide = s between rolls where an AI has no attack decision of its own). Its blow on another creature: enemy_damage damage points per half heart of the blow (crypt), story_hits hero hits per blow (story worlds); mad_cd = s between two body blows. Bosses and minibosses only scatter, by boss_scale of it; immune_tags feel nothing. The hero: after hero_delay s inside a void pool that is not his own his controls invert (movement and aim mirrored) until hero_after s after he left it; mad_warn rises 0..1 over the delay. The Leerenmagier (immune_class with immune_spec as main specialisation) is immune.

gefuege._note: The Leerenmagier's Arkanes Gefüge (user design 2026-10-31; src/combat/talent_combat.gd, fed by src/combat/elements.gd and src/hell/story_elements.gd): FEED -> LOAD -> EJECT. spec = the talent spec whose hero has one; cap = units it holds before Fassungsvermögen (gefuege_cap); elements = what can be stored (void never); aliases = what a material or gas counts as ('' = nothing); a swallowed puddle gives puddle_units[0..1] by its radius over puddle_r (crypt px), a gas cloud gas_units, a caught shot shot_units (its element by shot_el, else its own), an essence 1 unit per element (essence: the first tag of tag_order, else material, else default); gas = the story gas materials a mouth counts. The Singularität: its core holds the caught (hold_s = s of stun refreshed, orbit_r = share of the core radius they circle at, orbit_speed = rad/s); its elements are mixed inside the Gefüge into one clump and its collapse lets out only that mixture (user 2026-11-01; spit: stay = share of every element that stays in the explosion zone, landing on the core at once as one field stay_scale wider, where it goes on mixing for churn_s s (the look); the rest flies out into every corner as min_count..count globs of about per_glob units, all the same mixture with an equal share of every element, spread evenly round the core (each turned by up to jitter of a step) to spots m [min, max] metres away, speed = crypt px/s of their flight, delay = s between them, order = the order a glob's elements land in on its spot (liquids first, fire last so it sets them off), radius_scale = how much wider each element lands there, mix_bonus = extra strength per element kind beyond the first; bundle_scale = extra strength per extra unit of one element) and flings the caught at fling_speed px/s for up to fling_m m; material_by_tag / material_default = what a wall-killed enemy bursts into ('splat'). land = what each element does where it lands: pool = pool style left (time s; dps x hero damage per s on enemies, crypt), react = the element reaction there, radius_m, dmg x hero damage on landing, status = the hero status it puts on.
